$comment: Generated by mix loka.source_schema from the compiler's source contracts; do not edit.

ActionContribution.description: One source's contribution to an actor's ActionSet (06 §19; ADR-016), applied to the set composed so far by stable action key: union adds the named actions whose keys the set lacks, override adds them and replaces those it has, replace makes the set exactly them, subtract removes them and intersect keeps only them. A key names an engine verb (a registered command type), a cartridge action or a cartridge scripted action; union, override and replace take its definition (a cartridge's own over the engine verb's). A room applies its contributions in order after the engine verbs and the cartridge's actions and scripted actions (kernel/ts/src/actions.ts).

op.description: How the actions apply to the set so far: union, override, replace, subtract or intersect.

ActionCost.description: One resource cost of a ScriptedAction (21 §7 Cost): the actor's body pays amount of a resource of the cartridge on every admitted perform, failure included (04 §5.0). A perform whose body cannot pay (current value minus amount below the resource's minimum) is rejected insufficient_resource before any RNG draw, and changes nothing.

amount.description: How much it pays on every admitted perform.

ActionCraft.description: What a craft scripted action uses up and makes (docs/system/mechanics.md Craft; Homestead hs-10): consume, yield or both. consume: on every accepted perform, failure included, the first quantity of the listed items the actor's body holds directly (lowest EntityId first; one inside a worn or carried container does not count) move to the holder to; while the body holds fewer the perform is rejected invalid_state and the offer is unavailable, its reason's message reason when declared. yield: unless the outcome is failure, one of the listed items directly in the holder from (lowest EntityId first) moves to the body, with item_acquired after the check's events; while from holds none the perform is rejected invalid_state and the offer is unavailable with no message. Every moved item passes the body's carrying limits (give rules). The compiler (lib/loka/content/replenish.ex) refuses a template location, a holder with no placed entity (a spawn-template NPC or template item), an item holder that is not a container, duplicate items, and an unresolved item, holder or reason.

consume.description: What the actor gives up on every accepted perform, failure included.

items.description: The items that can be consumed.

quantity.description: How many of them are consumed.

reason.description: The refusal text shown when the actor holds too few.

to.description: Where the consumed items go: the holder they are moved to.

yield.description: What the actor receives unless the outcome is failure.

from.description: The holder the yielded item is taken from.

items.description: The items that can be yielded; one of them, directly in the holder, moves to the actor's body.

ActionInputParameter.description: An input parameter an action requires (06 §20), one of the ActionInput fields.

ActionNarration.description: A scripted action outcome's narration (21 §4 NarrationSpec): the actor's line, the observers' line, and the entities the actor's line names, each resolved and pinned when the outcome commits (06 §43; text.schema.json Text participants).

actor.description: Text key of the actor's line.

observers.description: Text key of the observers' line.

participants.description: The entities the actor's line names.

Alias.description: A word or phrase a player types to name a detail (21 §6 aliases; 04 §18 aliases) or, for a ScriptedAction, the action (its verb, the first words typed): lowercase letters and digits, the words of a phrase joined by _ (the player's `mooring post` is compared as mooring_post; kernel/ts/src/target.ts gives the normalization). At most 64 characters.

AncestrySpec.description: One authored character choice and its bounded initial effects.

attribute.description: The attribute this choice raises at birth, by modifier.

dark_sight.description: When true, the character sees in the dark.

description.description: Text key of the choice's description.

faction.description: A fact set when the choice is made.

fact.description: The fact; it must be player-scoped.

value.description: The value the fact is set to.

modifier.description: Added to the attribute's starting value; at least 1.

name.description: Text key of the choice's label.

skill.description: A skill granted at birth, without learning; it may not have a prerequisite.

ApiVersion.description: api_version: the authored source document/schema family (05 §3).

AttackProfile.description: Cartridge-owned hit chance and positive damage bounds. Compiler and loader enforce damage_min <= damage_max.

chance.description: Percent chance an attack is accurate; a defense can still prevent the hit.

crit.description: Toolbox row G2: a hit whose accuracy roll (the hit draw, uniform in [0, 100)) is below chance is critical and its damage is multiplied by multiplier, before resistances.

chance.description: Percent of all attacks, sharing the accuracy draw: a hit whose draw is below this is critical, so a chance above the accuracy makes every hit critical.

multiplier.description: Damage of a critical hit is multiplied by this (2 to 10).

damage_max.description: Most positive damage; at least damage_min.

kind.description: The damage kind (cold, fire, physical or poison); the target's resistance to it reduces the damage.

on_positive_hit.description: What a hit that takes off HP also does.

effect.description: The bleed applied to the player; used only when the attacker is spawned as a population hunter.

BandTable.description: A condition band table (04 §15 as amended 2026-10-02), highest cut first: the band is the first row whose cut p reaches, and maximum = minimum gives the top row. Cuts are strictly descending and the last is 0, so every value has a band, and keys are unique within the table; the compiler reports a table that breaks this as RESOURCE_SPEC_INVALID at the table. A pool's bands (ResourceSpec), else the cartridge's world.bands (cartridge.schema.json WorldSettings), else the engine default table.

BandTone.description: A condition band's tone (04 §15 as amended 2026-10-02): how serious the band is; each presenter maps it to its own colour.

BarrierState.description: A barrier's state (21 §5 Barrier: open/closed, locked/unlocked): open, closed (and unlocked) or locked (and closed); a lock needs a closed door, so an open locked barrier does not exist. The legal transitions (04 §5.3 'Lifecycle transition') are closed to open (open), open to closed (close), closed to locked (lock) and locked to closed (unlock); delta.schema.json barrier.transition.

Calendar.description: calendar@1: authored logical units per hour, hours per day, displayed subdivisions, and optional ordered solar/lunar cuts. Cut starts are inclusive; the compiler checks order, cycle bounds and schedule/window hours (lib/loka/content/calendar.ex). Toolbox row 31 adds the season and tide cycles and the weather table (one weighted entry per calendar day, chosen by a hash of the world id and the day).

start.description: The logical time a new world begins at.

subdivisions_per_hour.description: Parts the status line splits an hour into; must divide units_per_hour.

units_per_hour.description: Logical time units in one hour; the three unit fields are given together.

CalendarCut.description: An inclusive phase start within one authored solar day or lunar period.

at.description: Logical units into the solar day (or the cycle) at which this phase starts; the first cut of a cycle is 0.

phase.description: The phase's name, lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

CalendarCycle.description: A repeating cycle of ordered cuts in logical time units (lunar; season and tide, toolbox row 31): the phase at time t is the last cut at or before ((t - origin) mod period); the first cut starts at 0.

origin.description: The time at which the cycle is at its start (position 0).

period.description: Length of the cycle in logical units.

CapabilityVersion.description: A capability contract version (05 §6): a positive integer. key@version is immutable in meaning once published; a breaking change takes a new version (05 §6, 'Capability version immutability').

CapabilityVersions.description: Exact capability pins, capability key to version (05 §3 requires.capabilities; 05 §6). A map, so one version per key: the canonical decoder rejects a repeated key, and canonical encoding sorts keys.

CartridgeId.description: A cartridge identity (05 §3 id, 05 §4), lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.

Chapter.description: An ordered chapter marker (mechanics.md Chapters): name is a catalog key; only chapter 0 lacks a story_point, and it has no outcome. Later chapters name a story point and optionally one of its outcome keys (checked at the reference stage).

name.description: Text key of its name.

outcome.description: One outcome key of that story point.

story_point.description: The story point that opens it; only chapter 0 lacks one.

anyOf.description: A luck check (21 §7 Check; 00a `check: {kind: luck, chance: 50}`), owned by check@1: resolved once per admitted perform, after every admission check (a rejection draws nothing) and before any outcome step. luck draws one uniform integer in [0, 100) from the world's RNG (rng.ts uniform; xoshiro128ss-1.1, numeric profile) and passes when it is below chance; the draw commits whether the check passes or fails (04 §5.0). key names the check in its check_passed or check_failed event (a DefinitionRef of kind check in the cartridge's namespace), the key a quest objective matches (00a). An inline check's key is its check definition's key, so two checks, of scripted actions or dialogue choices, may not share one (DUPLICATE_DEFINITION).

chance.description: Passes when a draw from 0 to 99 is below this.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

anyOf.description: A deterministic threshold (21 §7 Check: deterministic threshold, difficulty; R5 S6b), owned by check@1 like a luck roll: passes when the actor's body's current value of a resource of the cartridge, read at admission before the scripted action's costs, is at least difficulty. It draws no RNG and emits check_passed or check_failed under key; the key rules of a luck check apply.

difficulty.description: Passes when the resource is at least this.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

resource.description: The body's resource, read at admission before costs.

anyOf.description: Passes when the actor's value of the attribute is at least difficulty; draws no random number.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

anyOf.description: An opposed check (toolbox rows 5 and G5, docs/system/mechanics.md): passes when the actor's level of skill, or value of attribute, at admission is at least the target detail's rating, or, when npc names an NPC of this cartridge (attribute only, toolbox row G3), that NPC's value of the attribute; draws no RNG. A skill with growth gains one use per perform. Dialogue choice: A dialogue choice's check (toolbox row 14, docs/system/mechanics.md dialogue skill checks; check@1): an opposed check as a scripted action's (action.schema.json ScriptedAction check, kind opposed) made when the choice is chosen, drawing no RNG: it passes when the actor's level of skill, or value of attribute, is at least rating, or, when npc names an NPC instance of this cartridge that declares the attribute, that NPC's value of it; exactly one of rating and npc (else SCHEMA_VIOLATION invalid_value at the check). key names it in its check_passed or check_failed event (a DefinitionRef of kind check, whose subject is the speaker), shared with no scripted action's or other choice's check (DUPLICATE_DEFINITION). On a pass the choice applies as unchecked; on a failure the actor reads failure instead, nothing else of the choice applies and the conversation closes. A skill with growth gains one use per check, passed or failed.

attribute.description: The attribute compared; give this or skill, not both.

failure.description: The failure branch; a dialogue choice needs it, a scripted action refuses it.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

npc.description: With attribute, compares against this NPC's value of the attribute instead of a rating.

rating.description: The target detail's rating; a scripted action refuses it.

skill.description: The skill whose level is compared; give this or attribute, not both.

anyOf.description: A track check (toolbox row W13, docs/system/mechanics.md Tracks and trails): passes when the trail of population plan plan (its key; the plan declares trail) in the actor's room is fresh (world.trails.fresh_for); draws no RNG; on success the outcome's lines are followed by world.trails.leads[<exit>].

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

plan.description: Key of the population plan whose trail is looked for; passes when that trail is fresh in the actor's room.

ClientFeature.description: A presentation/input capability of the installed Loka app (05 §3 client_features), lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.

CombatSettings.description: Cartridge-owned attack profile, round interval, position multipliers and combat narration keys. Compiler and loader enforce its executable capability and death-setting dependencies.

allies.description: Authored NPCs that fight beside the player (docs/system/mechanics.md, toolbox row 6b, narration ally_hit and ally_miss): the first listed one living in the encounter room strikes the player's target each round, is never an attack target, and its kill credits the player.

dodge.description: Percent chance to dodge an enemy attack that would otherwise hit; absent means no dodge.

skill.description: The skill that must be usable for a dodge.

flee_multiplier.description: Multiplies the move cost of a body that is engaged.

narration.description: Text keys told in combat rounds.

ally_hit.description: Told when an ally's strike hits.

ally_miss.description: Told when an ally's strike misses.

npc_died.description: Told when an NPC falls in a combat round.

npc_hit.description: Told when an NPC's attack hits the player.

npc_miss.description: Told when an NPC's attack misses the player.

player_died.description: Told when the player falls in a combat round; also the default fall line for tick deaths.

player_hit.description: Told when the player's attack hits.

player_miss.description: Told when the player's attack misses.

shot_hit.description: Told when a ranged first strike hits. Required when any item declares weapon.ranged.

shot_miss.description: Told when a ranged first strike misses. Required when any item declares weapon.ranged.

sleep_multiplier.description: Multiplies an NPC's damage against a sleeping player.

target_choice.description: Opts into target choice (docs/system/mechanics.md, toolbox row 6a): during a roster encounter the player's attack on another present active member makes it the primary the player strikes.

CompatibilityRequirements.description: requires (05 §3): a kernel_api range, exact rule_ir and content_schema versions (published cartridges pin them exactly), exact capability versions and required client features. protocol_version is Realm-only and not here (05 §3 'Version vocabulary').

capabilities.description: Each capability the cartridge uses, with its version; using a feature whose capability is not listed is refused.

client_features.description: Features the app must offer; the cartridge is refused where one is missing.

content_schema.description: Content schema version; must equal the one the engine supports (currently 1).

rule_ir.description: Rule format version; must equal the one the engine supports (currently 1).

ConditionBand.description: One row of a condition band table: the band key holds when p, the percentage of the pool's range from its minimum, reaches at_percent (in integers: 100 x (current - minimum) >= at_percent x (maximum - minimum)). key is a content Key whose text is band.<key> in the catalog when the cartridge authors it; tone is how serious it is.

at_percent.description: The percentage of the pool's range at which it holds.

key.description: The band key; its text is band.<key> when authored.

Connection.description: One directed exit to another room of the same cartridge (21 §5 Connection; 05 §17). Its identity is its room and direction. barrier, optional (barrier@1), names the Barrier whose one shared state the exit passes through (21 §5 Barrier; 05 §25 coherent connections): move through it is refused while it is closed (exit_closed) or locked (exit_locked); an exit without one means what it always meant. A reciprocal exit is authored in the destination room (00a §2); faces pair by opposite direction: an exit's reciprocal face is its destination's exit in the opposite compass direction when that exit leads back to its room, and an exit with a barrier needs a reciprocal face naming the same barrier (BARRIER_MISMATCH at each face otherwise). One-way and bent barrier passages (no reciprocal face, or an opposite-direction exit that leads elsewhere) are rejected for now and may be allowed later; an exit without a barrier is BARRIER_MISMATCH only when its reciprocal face names one.

barrier.description: The barrier the exit passes through.

climb.description: Toolbox row 30 (docs/system/mechanics.md rope and climb): crossing this directed exit is a climb. A mover whose body holds item (directly or in a container) climbs down as on any exit; one without it falls: the move still happens and also costs damage HP, never below 1 (a fall never kills), narrated by fell. The cartridge declares an hp pool (RESOURCE_SPEC_INVALID otherwise). NPCs never take a climb face.

damage.description: HP a fall costs; a fall never takes HP below 1.

item.description: The item a mover must hold to climb rather than fall.

corpse_ingress.description: Close this directed exit while the named global fact has the specified value, except for the living owner of a nonempty player corpse in its destination. The exception is rechecked at movement admission.

equals.description: The value at which the exit is closed.

fact.description: The global fact that closes the exit.

hidden_until.description: Toolbox row 11 (docs/system/mechanics.md hidden passages): for the commanded character this directed exit does not exist (not listed, not seen through, absent from the map, a move through it not_found) until the named fact has the specified value. No barrier on a hidden face (BARRIER_MISMATCH).

equals.description: The value that reveals the exit; of the fact's type.

fact.description: A fact of this cartridge, normally a player bool; the exit stays hidden until it has the value.

knock.description: The face's answer to a knock.

locks.description: Toolbox row G7 (mechanics.md Access locks): traverse, the policy the mover must hold to cross this exit, read by movementPlan after the barrier; failing it refuses permission_denied. Read with no target.

Cue.description: A sense cue (toolbox row G6): what a listener smells, hears or feels from its source. sense is sound, smell or heat; text the authored line (the sense in its words, trap 12); range the rooms it carries through exits, 0 (the source's room only) to 2; when, optional, a condition read for the listener (the player for the view, a reaction's actor for an NPC). Owned by sense_cue@1. Its source is the room, detail, item or NPC, lit fuel source, active status or scripted action outcome that declares it.

range.description: Rooms it carries through exits, 0 to 2.

when.description: A condition read for the listener.

Cues.description: A source's sense cues (Cue; toolbox row G6), in authored order.

DamageKind.description: A damage kind (toolbox row G2): a closed engine vocabulary shared by attack profiles and NPC resistances. A row that needs a new kind adds it here; a kind never shares a name with a Tag.

DeathCredit.description: Finite authored death credit linking one local attackable NPC, its authored room and a player Boolean fact with false default. Compiler and loader enforce references and unique NPC/fact ownership.

fact.description: The player Boolean fact with false default.

npc.description: The attackable NPC.

DeathSettings.description: Fixed corpse templates, same-body return room and pool restoration; requires death@1 (docs/system/cartridge.md).

narration.description: A player's death lines outside a combat round (loka-3w3q). player_died: the fall line a bleed or status tick death tells after its tick line (default world.combat.narration.player_died; a drowning tells world.water.drowned instead). woke: told once after every player death, combat included, after the penalty line.

player_died.description: The fall line a bleed or status tick death tells after its tick line.

woke.description: Told once after every player death, after the penalty line.

npc_corpse.description: Corpse template for an NPC, unless its population names its own.

penalty.description: What a player's death costs (toolbox row 47). experience: the body loses floor(experience * percent / 100), never below the threshold of its current level, and narration is told once; it needs world.levelling. items: corpse (the default) moves what the body held into the corpse; kept leaves it on the body.

experience.description: Experience lost on death; needs world.levelling.

narration.description: Told once when experience is lost.

percent.description: The body loses floor(experience * percent / 100), never below its current level's threshold.

items.description: corpse (the default) moves what the body held into the corpse; kept leaves it on the body.

restore.description: The values the dead body's pools are set to.

hp.description: HP after death; capped at the body's HP maximum.

mv.description: Movement after death; capped at the body's movement maximum.

shrine.description: The room a dead player's body returns to.

anyOf.description: Globally stable, immutable reference to a content definition (03 §2; 05 §4: no global content-key namespace). cartridge_id, kind and key are lowercase snake_case of at most 64 characters; cartridge_version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without leading zeros, pre-release or build metadata.

cartridge_id.description: The owning cartridge. Lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.

key.description: The definition's key within its kind.

DerivedStat.description: One stat's attribute bonus (docs/system/mechanics.md derived stats): floor(sum of per_point * (value - pivot) over terms / divisor), rounded toward minus infinity; value is the player's attribute as attribute@1 reads it. Every number is the cartridge's; divisor defaults to 1.

divisor.description: The sum of the terms is divided by this, rounded down; default 1.

terms.description: The attributes that make up the bonus; each adds per_point times (the attribute's value minus pivot).

per_point.description: Bonus added per point of the attribute above pivot (below it, taken away).

pivot.description: The attribute value at which this term adds nothing.

DescriptionVariant.description: Prose selected by a condition (21 §6 DescriptionVariant; 00a §12): description replaces the base description key when the condition holds for the actor over committed state (policy.schema.json Policy; the evaluator is pure, 06 §21). A room's or detail's variants are tried in list order and the first whose condition holds is shown; when none holds, the base description is. Variants are derived, never a mutated description (21 §6). Owned by description_variant (a cartridge with one requires it); its condition's ops by their owners.

description.description: Text key shown when it holds.

DialogueChoice.description: One option of a dialogue (06 §17, §43): label and narration its text keys; steps, its effects in order (Steps of the dialogue choice context, docs/system/cartridge.md Steps and checks; a fact.assign sets a declared fact of the cartridge at the one scope it allows, a value of its type, as a scripted action's: fact@1 emits fact_changed when the value changes); hand_over, the item role the actor's body gives to the npc role (an item_acquired with that NPC as holder, as give); accept, a quest of this cartridge the choice activates as quest@1's activation does (quest.activate at player scope and quest_activated; the choose is invalid_state when accept_quest would be: the actor already has an instance of it, or its offer, if declared, has a policy that fails), never with a hand_over (activation and acquisition in one decision conflict: OUTCOME_MISMATCH). The choose that selects it applies all of them, resolves the dialogue's quest or activates the accepted one, and resolves the choice in one decision; its outcome is the choice_id. API1.7 receive {item, from} transfers the selected bound NPC-held item into the actor body, only while resolving a quest before API1.10; API1.10 also permits nonterminal receive. Receive is never combined with accept/hand_over. API1.7 fact.adjust applies a safe integer amount to a declared bounded integer fact using checked addition then authored bounds, lowered to fact.assign. Optional (toolbox row 14): check (step.schema.json Check, kind opposed), an opposed check made when the choice is chosen; a checked choice carries only label, narration, narration_variants, steps, availability, check, policy, then and then_failed, in a dialogue with no quest and no riddle, and its steps grant no skill (else OUTCOME_MISMATCH at its check). policy, the option's own condition, read with the speaker as target at the view, the choose and the talk: while it fails the option is not drawn and its choose is invalid_state. then, the key of a dialogue (of any speaker) that the accepted answer opens next as the conversation's new row, or end, which ends the conversation; a dialogue reached this way is no talk of its own and never reopens itself. then_failed, the same for a failed check; refused without check. narration_variants, words read instead of narration by the first when that holds before the answer's writes.

accept.description: A quest of this cartridge the choice activates.

availability.description: Time limits on offering the choice.

from.description: First logical time the choice is offered.

through.description: Last logical time the choice is offered, inclusive.

check.description: An opposed check made when chosen.

escort.description: API1.11 escort@1: npc names a bound NPC role. Start/rejoin are nonterminal; complete resolves the dialogue’s same quest.

npc.description: A bound NPC role.

hand_over.description: The item role the actor gives to an npc role.

lesson_payment.description: An amount of a resource the actor pays for a lesson.

amount.description: How much.

narration.description: Text key of what the actor reads on choosing.

npc.description: A bound NPC role.

payment.description: An amount of a resource paid to the actor by an NPC role.

amount.description: How much.

receive.description: The bound NPC-held item transferred to the actor.

story_point.description: <story point>/<outcome>: the story point outcome this choice reaches; one choice per outcome.

anyOf.description: An NPC of this cartridge takes this role.

npc.description: The NPC definition.

anyOf.description: An item of this cartridge takes this role.

DialogueRole.description: A dialogue role's participant, as action.schema.json NarrationParticipant's npc or item branch (the actor is implicit): an NPC or item of this cartridge (else UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE).

EscortStatus.description: The bounded escort lifecycle: following moves with the actor, separated waits for explicit rejoin, completed never follows again.

ExecutionProfile.description: A hosting profile a cartridge supports or a deployment uses: the canonical execution-profile vocabulary (07 §3; 09 §20 reuses it).

anyOf.description: true or false.
One of values (order and duplicates carry no meaning); default is one of them, which the compiler checks.

default.description: Value before any assignment; one of values.

values.description: The keys the fact may hold.

anyOf.description: A safe integer within the optional inclusive bounds; the compiler checks default against them.

FactType.description: A fact's value type and default (03 §7). The types chapter one declares (00a §6): bool, enum over Keys, and int with optional inclusive bounds. The value itself is a FactValue (delta.schema.json).

FactValue.description: The value of a fact, in fact.assign, fact_compare and fact_changed: a Key, a safe integer or a boolean, the value types FactSpec declares (fact.schema.json; 03 §7). Which one a fact takes is its FactType, which the compiler checks.

anyOf.description: A lightable item that burns fuel while lit, and is refilled from a supply item.

capacity.description: The most fuel the source holds, in its unit.

cues.description: Cues active only while this source is lit (toolbox row G6).

doused.description: Text key of the line told when it is put out.

ignited.description: Text key of the line told when it is lit.

initial.description: Fuel it holds at the start; at most capacity.

rate.description: Fuel burned per logical time unit while lit; at least 1. It goes out when the fuel runs out.

refueled.description: Text key of the line told when it is refilled.

supply.description: The supply item that refuels it; the supply's unit must match.

unit.description: The fuel's unit name; the supply must use the same one.

anyOf.description: An item that holds fuel for refilling sources; it is emptied by what it gives.

capacity.description: The most fuel the supply holds, in its unit.

initial.description: Fuel it holds at the start; at most capacity.

unit.description: The fuel's unit name; a source takes only a supply with the same one.

FuelSpec.description: Immutable authored source or supply metadata; sources bind one compatible supply and their narration keys.

InspectableDetail.description: A lightweight keyed detail of a room (21 §6 InspectableDetail): the aliases a player can name it by, the first of which also names it when a lookup is ambiguous, and its description text key (05 §18). Not a RuntimeEntity: a fresh world gives it a target id only (numeric profile, Initial world ids). Two details of one room may share an alias (an ambiguous lookup lists both, 04 §18), but the first alias must be the detail's own and in the form a lookup produces (no empty word, not starting with at, the, a or an), or the player could not pick it by name (UNREACHABLE_DETAIL). Its variants (DescriptionVariant) select other prose by condition. Owned by inspectable_detail (a cartridge with details requires it). R5 freezes this v1 shape (14 §R5): perception, reveal facts and contextual actions join as optional fields.

aliases.description: The words a player names it by; the first also names an ambiguous lookup.

bed.description: Makes the detail a bed: resting here is offered when the entitlement fact reads true.

entitlement.description: The fact that must read true for the actor before resting here is offered.

title.description: Text key of the title of the bed's page.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms from this detail: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

harvest.description: Makes the detail a place to gather items from.

careful.description: A slower way to gather: several items at once, for a skilled actor.

action.description: The harvest action offered for it; must be a harvest action that takes a method.

count.description: Items gathered at once; 2 to 64, and at most the distinct items listed.

narration.description: Text key of the line told after a careful harvest.

skill.description: The skill the actor must have usable for the careful way.

items.description: The item definitions that can be gathered; each harvest takes the ones lying in the room.

label.description: Text key of the harvest action's button.

narration.description: Text key of the line told after an ordinary harvest (one item).

title.description: Text key of the title of the harvest page.

tool.description: Toolbox row 19: Harvest needs a held item whose definition declares tag.

tag.description: The tag a held item must carry for the harvest to be allowed.

liquid_source.description: The liquid a held vessel can be filled with at this detail.

notice_board.description: Makes the detail a board that lists other readable details of the room.

detail.description: A readable detail in the same room.

title.description: The notice's title on the board.

self_luminous.description: Must be true: the detail gives light, so it is seen in a dark room.

Policy.description: A pure condition tree (06 §21). all/any/not compose; the leaves are the 06 §21 operators the R6P proof uses (pre-release-proof.md) and the rest are added with their first use, each versioned by its owning capability, which the cartridge must lock (capability_registry.json policies); adding an operator to a capability version that is already installed takes that capability's next version. A changed meaning of an existing operator takes its owning capability's next version. fact_compare compares FactValue. stat_compare and resource_compare (attribute@1, 06 §21 amendment 2026-10-03) hold when the actor's attribute value, or the current value of the resource on the actor's body, is at least at_least; below is not, a range is all.

The emoter is npc (an authored instance alive in the delivery's room), else the delivery's subject; to subject names the subject as the target and needs the emote's to forms. Appends one emote.performed line, told only to a reader who sees the emoter; writes nothing, emits no event.

emote.description: The emote of the cartridge table to perform.

npc.description: The emoter, alive in the room; else the subject.

anyOf.description: Toolbox row FD1: writes the delivery's logical time into an int fact (no maximum, minimum absent or at most 0) at the subject a fact.assign step writes at, as a fact.assign.

fact.description: The int fact that receives the delivery's logical time.

npc.description: As fact.assign npc.

anyOf.description: Emit a custom event.

Toolbox row 29b (spell scripted actions only): the named NPC's instance (without npc, an aimed spell's target; an unaimed spell requires npc, compiler SCHEMA_VIOLATION), when alive, loses amount hp of this damage kind after its resistances (row G2), stopping at 0; a loss to 0 runs the death sequence with the caster as killer and credited character, and closes the NPC's encounter when it is the only opponent.

amount.description: HP lost before resistances.

kind.description: The damage kind, read against resistances.

npc.description: The NPC hit; else an aimed spell's target.

anyOf.description: Toolbox row 29b (spell scripted actions only): ignite the named fuel source (without item, an aimed spell's target; an unaimed spell requires item, compiler SCHEMA_VIOLATION) as the ignite verb does (light@1), when the caster holds it and the verb would admit it; otherwise nothing.

item.description: The fuel source to ignite; else an aimed spell's target.

anyOf.description: Adjust a resource of the actor's body by `by`, stopping at its bounds.

resource.description: The pool on the actor's body.

anyOf.description: Scripted action: Built rooms S6 (detail-target scripted actions only, at most one per outcome, construction@1): raise structure at the scripted action target's room (its site) toward direction for the actor, as a build service does (service.schema.json); success outcome only (the compiler refuses it elsewhere, lib/loka/content/construction.ex). Admission refuses the perform while the build would be refused (service.site_taken, service.construction_full). Service benefit: Built rooms S2 (construction@1): raise structure at site's direction (site required on a service, lib/loka/content/steps.ex). structure is one of site.structures and direction one of site.directions (SCHEMA_VIOLATION invalid_value otherwise). Refused service.site_taken while a built room holds that site direction and service.construction_full at world.construction.max_total. Built rooms S3: fact with escrow (ready_after, no output) makes it a commission: the order sets fact true, moves the inputs to custody and schedules an order job; when due the job raises the room for its owner and sets fact false (refunding the inputs when the site is taken or construction full by then). Cancel (a cancel benefit naming this service) returns the inputs, never the fee.

direction.description: The direction from the site the room is raised toward.

escrow.description: Built rooms S3: the first quantity of these directly held items move to the custody room with the order; ready_after seconds later the order job raises the room.

items.description: The item definitions accepted as payment.

ready_after.description: Seconds until the order job raises the room.

fact.description: With escrow, makes a commission: true from the order until the job raises the room.

skill.description: The skill the actor acquires.

topic.description: The topic the actor comes to know.

escrow.description: Toolbox row 20a: the first quantity of these directly held items move to the custody room with the order. Row 20b: ready_after with output (an item lying in custody) adds a work job a claim waits for; cancel returns the inputs, never the fee. Row kgd.70: output with no ready_after is a barter, handed from custody to the body with the inputs, no job.

items.description: The item definitions accepted as payment.

output.description: The item lying in custody the order hands over.

ready_after.description: Seconds of work a claim waits for; needs output.

fact.description: The fact recording the entitlement.

amount.description: How much is restored, up to its maximum.

debit.description: How much leaves stock per meal.

stock.description: The provider's resource the meal draws on.

amount.description: How much is restored, up to its maximum.

vessel.description: The authored vessel the serving comes from.

amount.description: Durability restored, up to its maximum.

fact.description: The durability fact of the wielded weapon (weapon.durability.fact).

service.description: The service whose order is claimed.
The service whose order is cancelled.

account.description: The bounded int player fact mirroring the balance.

amount.description: Currency moved, separate from the service's price.

vault.description: The NPC holding the shared pool.

amount.description: Currency moved, separate from the service's price.

vault.description: The NPC holding the shared pool.

anyOf.description: Built rooms S4 (construction@1): mend the built room at site's direction. Refused service.nothing_to_mend unless that room's structure ruin status is active on it; otherwise the mend cures ruin and applies the structure's weathering again. site and direction as build's.

escrow.description: The first quantity of these directly held items move to the custody room with the mend (spent at once).

items.description: The item definitions accepted as payment.

anyOf.description: Built rooms S5 (construction@1): raze the live built room at site's direction. Refused service.nothing_to_raze without one, permission_denied unless the actor raised it, service.occupied while an entity that cannot move (a corpse) lies in it; otherwise its statuses end, everything on its floor moves to the site and a tombstone (built row) is written. site and direction as build's.

Step.description: One registered operation of a step list, discriminated by op. Scripted action outcome's explicit steps (04 §5.2 step 4, §5.3; 05 §28: never a generic setter or an untyped effect). fact.assign sets a declared fact of the cartridge, at the one scope the fact allows, to a value of its type (the host emits fact_changed at this step's causal position when the value changes, fact@1). event.emit emits the cartridge's custom event of this key (EventPayload custom_event, scripted_action@1), whose subject is the scripted action's target. resource.adjust adds by (negative: subtracts) to a resource of the actor's body, chained after the costs and any earlier adjust of it, stopping at the resource's bounds (DikuMUD-style: healing at full health heals nothing); this saturation is the step's declared meaning, not a silent clamp (04 §5.1): the rule computes the stopped value and proposes an exact delta resource.adjust to it, or none when the value does not change. Costs never saturate (ActionCost).

Tag.description: A property tag (toolbox row G1): a closed engine vocabulary, so every mechanic that gives a tag meaning and every cartridge that declares one share its spelling. Item, barrier and room definitions declare tags; the has_tag policy leaf (tag@1) reads them. A row whose mechanic needs a new tag adds it here. A room tagged air, chasm or water (status reader 7) admits a move into it only for a body whose active statuses pass that tag. Toolbox row 28 gives cursed no meaning of its own (has_tag, wearing and resistances see it as any tag): content marks a curse-bearing item with it for a wearing leaf in that item's name variant. Toolbox row 43a adds road and marsh, which have no meaning of their own: cartridge.json world.movement.terrain gives a room tag a fare percent. Aimed spells (loka-x6t.109) add lamp, which has no meaning of its own: content marks a light an aimed lux may target.

anyOf.description: The action takes no target.
One entity from the listed scopes.

scopes.description: Where the target is looked for: self, inventory, room_contents, room_occupants or inspectable_details.

TargetSpec.description: The candidate scopes an action's target is resolved from (21 §7): the scopes the R6P proof resolves to an EntityId. Inspectable details use target-only EntityIds and the inspectable_details scope. equipped, connections, party and privileged global scope are added with their first use, with a target identity for non-entity targets (21 §6). Accepted kinds and capabilities are added with the capability registry.

TextCatalog.description: The cartridge's default-locale strings (05 §18: stable string ids, inline defaults extracted into a catalog): each TextKey to its display text, 1 to 4,096 characters. One locale only; per-locale catalogs, plural rules and binding placeholders join later under a new cartridge format tag. Every text key a room, detail, variant, item, NPC (short, room_line, description) or action (label, accessibility) uses has an entry; a string marks its tappable words inline as touch links (owner decision 2026-09-25, Q3): the words in square brackets, which link the thing whose text it is, optionally followed at once by a target key in parentheses, which links that detail of the room or item or NPC of the cartridge instead (DiagnosticCode UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE, TOUCH_LINK_MISSING), so each locale marks its own words; a host showing plain text shows the words without the brackets and target; the compiler reports a missing one as UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE.

TextKey.description: A localization string id (04 §15; 05 §18): lowercase dotted snake_case of at most 128 characters, the ActionDefinition label rule. Text carries its interpolation bindings. Or inline prose, written as {"prose": "..."}.

TextVariants.description: Toolbox row W6: variants of one entity text (short, room_line or description), the first whose condition holds replacing it (DescriptionVariant, as for a room's description); the base text stays mandatory. Each condition reads with the entity itself as the target (status_active subject target).

TimePolicy.description: Opt-in M1-A elapsed logical seconds per real second; absence retains legacy play_time. Requires schedule@1. Millisecond conversion and fractional remainder belong to host M1-B. Integer type obeys loka-numeric-v1 safe range.

profile.description: Must be real_elapsed: logical time follows real time.

rate.description: Logical seconds that pass per real second; at least 1.

recap_after_minutes.description: Toolbox row W27, opt-in: an elapsed settlement spanning at least this many real minutes opens the next Book page with one away recap block. At most one week (10080).

UseTool.description: Toolbox row G4: what a use scripted action's tool must be, at least one property: an item whose definition declares tag, and a vessel holding some of liquid (quantity above 0).

liquid.description: A liquid the tool vessel holds some of.

tag.description: A tag the tool item definition declares.

VesselSpec.description: Opted finite vessel shell with authored positive capacity and initial contents.

WaterSettings.description: D6 exact paired surface/bottom routes, usable skill, entry load/cost, absolute submersion duration and authored warning/death copy; real_elapsed content only.

drowned.description: Text key of the line told when the character drowns.

duration.description: Logical time units a character can stay under before drowning; at least 1.

entry_cost.description: Movement points paid to go under.

maximum_grams.description: The heaviest load, in grams, a character can carry and still go under.

routes.description: The surface and bottom room pairs; entering water at a surface moves to its bottom.

surface.description: The room above the water, where the route is entered.

skill.description: The skill the character must have usable to go under.

warning.description: Text key of the warning shown before going under.

WeaponProfile.description: An equipped weapon's required skill and authored attack profile.

durability.description: Toolbox row 21: the bounded int entity fact holding this weapon's durability (its default is a new weapon's) and the amount each hit of its own attack takes off; at the fact's minimum it is broken and strikes unarmed.

fact.description: The bounded int fact that holds the weapon's durability.

wear.description: Durability each of the weapon's hits takes off.

ranged.description: Toolbox row 17: the weapon shoots in an encounter's round 1, spending one of the body's ammo resource pool; it never strikes in melee.

ammo.description: The resource pool one unit of which each shot spends.

skill.description: The required skill.

WeatherEntry.description: One weather of a calendar's weather table (toolbox row 31): each calendar day takes one entry with probability weight / total weight, by a hash of the world id and the day, never the authority RNG. wet: an exposed room's flame will not light (light@1 ignite). Phases are unique in the table.

phase.description: The weather's name, lowercase letters, digits and underscores; unique in the table.

weight.description: Its chance relative to the other entries: weight over the sum of all weights; 1 to 1000.

wet.description: When true, an exposed flame will not light in this weather.

Word.description: One spoken word (speech@1; toolbox row G9): 1 to 32 ASCII letters, the riddle answer's bound. The rule case-folds it and compares it only with authored keywords; it never reaches narration.

WorldSettings.description: The cartridge's world settings (owner decision world parameters; 00 §4 and 04 §15 as amended 2026-10-02), each optional with an engine default: movement.cost, what a move costs the body (movement@1; default 1 mv when the cartridge declares mv), its resource a pool of this cartridge (UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE otherwise); movement.terrain, the percent each destination room tag scales that cost by (row 43a; default none); movement without cost, or with terrain; bands, the condition band table of every pool without its own (resource.schema.json BandTable; default the 04 §15 table). An optional field of loka-cartridge-v2: the tag stays, and the compiler writes it only when the source authors it. In source it is cartridge.json's world, beside entry.

bands.description: The condition band table of every pool without its own. Default: the engine's table.

bell_cue.description: A line told in the listed rooms when the fact turns true.

fact.description: The bool fact whose change to true triggers the line.

rooms.description: The rooms where it is told, to anyone there.

carry.description: Opts into the voluntary Take ceiling (docs/system/mechanics.md containment@1); every item must author mass_grams. No engine default.

construction.description: Built rooms S1 (construction@1): max_total, the most structures built in this world at once.

max_total.description: The most structures built in this world at once.

derived.description: Opts into stats derived from the player's attributes (docs/system/mechanics.md derived stats, toolbox row 2; attribute@1). Each table's bonus is added to the authored number it modifies: hit_chance to the attack profile's chance (clamped 0..100), damage to both damage_min and damage_max (clamped at 0), carry_grams to carry.max_grams (clamped at 0), hp_max to the player body's hp maximum (clamped at the pool minimum). hit_chance and damage need world.combat; carry_grams needs world.carry. An NPC keeps its authored profile unless it declares attributes (toolbox row G3): then hit_chance and damage apply to its attack with its own values.

gear_budget.description: Balance tool 6b (docs/system/cartridge.md item affect declarations; attribute@1): the signed affect total an item in each slot may carry at intended level 1 (per_slot) and what each level above 1 adds (per_level). The engine ignores it at runtime; only the power report reads it.

per_level.description: What each level above 1 adds to the slot's budget. Read only by the power report.

per_slot.description: Keyed by SlotKey (entity.schema.json), at least one (a compiler check, SCHEMA_VIOLATION too_few_items: the subset has no minProperties); a slot it omits is unbudgeted, never 0.

group.description: Toolbox rows G8, 22a and 22b: member, stay and fight each name a bool pair fact read at each NPC; wage pays every member amount of a conserved resource each `every` clock units (docs/system/cartridge.md#group-declarations).

fight.description: A bool pair fact, read at each NPC: the hireling order to fight.

member.description: A bool pair fact, read at each NPC: this NPC is in the player's group.

stay.description: A bool pair fact, read at each NPC: the hireling order to stay.

wage.description: Pays each group member from the player's purse on a schedule; a member who cannot be paid leaves the group.

amount.description: How much of the resource each member is paid.

identity.description: Toolbox rows W15 and FD9 (mechanics.md Recognition and earned titles): the player's displayed name, the text key name, varied by name_variants (TextVariants, first match wins; subject target is the player's body). GameView projects it as actor_name.

name.description: Text key of the player's displayed name.

name_variants.description: Variants of the name; the first match wins, with the player's body as subject target.

levelling.description: Opts into experience and levelling (docs/system/mechanics.md experience and levelling, toolbox row 4; attribute@1). thresholds are the strictly increasing experience totals that reach levels 2, 3 and so on; points_per_level the attribute points each level grants; kills the experience a credited kill of each NPC definition grants; level_up the receipt line when a decision reaches a new level. Every number is the cartridge's.

gained.description: The line telling the experience a proposal added, binding amount.

kills.description: The experience a credited kill of each NPC definition grants.

npc.description: The NPC definition.

level_up.description: The receipt line when a decision reaches a new level.

thresholds.description: Strictly increasing experience totals that reach levels 2, 3 and so on.

mount.description: Toolbox row 43b: riding names a bool pair fact, per subject and scoped to player, read at each NPC with a mount declaration; such an NPC carries its rider (docs/system/cartridge.md#mount-declarations).

riding.description: A bool pair fact, per subject and scoped to player: the player rides this NPC.

movement.description: What a move costs the body, and how destination room tags scale it.

terrain.description: Terrain movement costs (row 43a; docs/system/mechanics.md, Terrain movement costs): a room tag to the percent a move into a room carrying it scales the fare by, applied after status cost_percent, in the room's authored tag order, rounded down each step. The key pattern repeats the entity.schema.json Tag enum, so a Tag added there is refused here until this list follows (fail closed).

theft.description: Toolbox rows 33 and 34 (mechanics.md Theft, fence and witnessed offense): take may lift an item a living NPC in the actor's room directly holds. The victim notices when the actor's level in skill is below the victim's value of attribute (absent: 0); every other living NPC there that is not blind and the actor's body is not concealed from also sees. Containment alone sets the per_subject instance bool fact stolen true on the item; a seen theft emits custom_event noticed (subject: the thief's body) and says narration.seen, an unseen one narration.unseen.

attribute.description: The victim's attribute compared with the actor's skill level. Absent: 0.

narration.description: Text keys told after a theft.

seen.description: Told when the theft is noticed.

unseen.description: Told when nobody notices the theft.

noticed.description: Key of the custom event emitted when a theft is seen.

skill.description: The victim notices when the actor's level in this skill is below the victim's attribute.

stolen.description: The per_subject instance bool fact set true on a stolen item.

trails.description: Toolbox row W13 (mechanics.md Tracks and trails): a trail is fresh while now minus its time is below fresh_for (logical seconds); a passed track check appends leads[<exit>], one per direction some room's exit uses.

fresh_for.description: A trail is fresh while now minus its time is below this, in logical seconds.

leads.description: What a passed track check appends, per direction some room's exit uses.

down.description: Appended when the trail leads down.

east.description: Appended when the trail leads east.

north.description: Appended when the trail leads north.

south.description: Appended when the trail leads south.

up.description: Appended when the trail leads up.

west.description: Appended when the trail leads west.

partial.ActionCraft.description: What a craft scripted action uses up and makes (docs/system/mechanics.md Craft; Homestead hs-10): consume, yield or both. consume: on every accepted perform, failure included, the first quantity of the listed items the actor's body holds directly (lowest EntityId first; one inside a worn or carried container does not count) move to the holder to; while the body holds fewer the perform is rejected invalid_state and the offer is unavailable, its reason's message reason when declared. yield: unless the outcome is failure, one of the listed items directly in the holder from (lowest EntityId first) moves to the body, with item_acquired after the check's events; while from holds none the perform is rejected invalid_state and the offer is unavailable with no message. Every moved item passes the body's carrying limits (give rules). The compiler (lib/loka/content/replenish.ex) refuses a template location, a holder with no placed entity (a spawn-template NPC or template item), an item holder that is not a container, duplicate items, and an unresolved item, holder or reason.

consume.description: What the actor gives up on every accepted perform, failure included.

items.description: The items that can be consumed.

quantity.description: How many of them are consumed.

reason.description: The refusal text shown when the actor holds too few.

to.description: Where the consumed items go: the holder they are moved to.

yield.description: What the actor receives unless the outcome is failure.

from.description: The holder the yielded item is taken from.

items.description: The items that can be yielded; one of them, directly in the holder, moves to the actor's body.

partial.ActionNarration.description: A scripted action outcome's narration (21 §4 NarrationSpec): the actor's line, the observers' line, and the entities the actor's line names, each resolved and pinned when the outcome commits (06 §43; text.schema.json Text participants).

actor.description: Text key of the actor's line.

observers.description: Text key of the observers' line.

participants.description: The entities the actor's line names.

partial.AttackProfile.description: Cartridge-owned hit chance and positive damage bounds. Compiler and loader enforce damage_min <= damage_max.

chance.description: Percent chance an attack is accurate; a defense can still prevent the hit.

crit.description: Toolbox row G2: a hit whose accuracy roll (the hit draw, uniform in [0, 100)) is below chance is critical and its damage is multiplied by multiplier, before resistances.

chance.description: Percent of all attacks, sharing the accuracy draw: a hit whose draw is below this is critical, so a chance above the accuracy makes every hit critical.

multiplier.description: Damage of a critical hit is multiplied by this (2 to 10).

damage_max.description: Most positive damage; at least damage_min.

kind.description: The damage kind (cold, fire, physical or poison); the target's resistance to it reduces the damage.

on_positive_hit.description: What a hit that takes off HP also does.

effect.description: The bleed applied to the player; used only when the attacker is spawned as a population hunter.

anyOf.description: A luck check (21 §7 Check; 00a `check: {kind: luck, chance: 50}`), owned by check@1: resolved once per admitted perform, after every admission check (a rejection draws nothing) and before any outcome step. luck draws one uniform integer in [0, 100) from the world's RNG (rng.ts uniform; xoshiro128ss-1.1, numeric profile) and passes when it is below chance; the draw commits whether the check passes or fails (04 §5.0). key names the check in its check_passed or check_failed event (a DefinitionRef of kind check in the cartridge's namespace), the key a quest objective matches (00a). An inline check's key is its check definition's key, so two checks, of scripted actions or dialogue choices, may not share one (DUPLICATE_DEFINITION).

chance.description: Passes when a draw from 0 to 99 is below this.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

anyOf.description: A deterministic threshold (21 §7 Check: deterministic threshold, difficulty; R5 S6b), owned by check@1 like a luck roll: passes when the actor's body's current value of a resource of the cartridge, read at admission before the scripted action's costs, is at least difficulty. It draws no RNG and emits check_passed or check_failed under key; the key rules of a luck check apply.

difficulty.description: Passes when the resource is at least this.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

resource.description: The body's resource, read at admission before costs.

anyOf.description: Passes when the actor's value of the attribute is at least difficulty; draws no random number.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

anyOf.description: An opposed check (toolbox rows 5 and G5, docs/system/mechanics.md): passes when the actor's level of skill, or value of attribute, at admission is at least the target detail's rating, or, when npc names an NPC of this cartridge (attribute only, toolbox row G3), that NPC's value of the attribute; draws no RNG. A skill with growth gains one use per perform. Dialogue choice: A dialogue choice's check (toolbox row 14, docs/system/mechanics.md dialogue skill checks; check@1): an opposed check as a scripted action's (action.schema.json ScriptedAction check, kind opposed) made when the choice is chosen, drawing no RNG: it passes when the actor's level of skill, or value of attribute, is at least rating, or, when npc names an NPC instance of this cartridge that declares the attribute, that NPC's value of it; exactly one of rating and npc (else SCHEMA_VIOLATION invalid_value at the check). key names it in its check_passed or check_failed event (a DefinitionRef of kind check, whose subject is the speaker), shared with no scripted action's or other choice's check (DUPLICATE_DEFINITION). On a pass the choice applies as unchecked; on a failure the actor reads failure instead, nothing else of the choice applies and the conversation closes. A skill with growth gains one use per check, passed or failed.

attribute.description: The attribute compared; give this or skill, not both.

failure.description: The failure branch; a dialogue choice needs it, a scripted action refuses it.

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

npc.description: With attribute, compares against this NPC's value of the attribute instead of a rating.

rating.description: The target detail's rating; a scripted action refuses it.

skill.description: The skill whose level is compared; give this or attribute, not both.

anyOf.description: A track check (toolbox row W13, docs/system/mechanics.md Tracks and trails): passes when the trail of population plan plan (its key; the plan declares trail) in the actor's room is fresh (world.trails.fresh_for); draws no RNG; on success the outcome's lines are followed by world.trails.leads[<exit>].

key.description: This check's key, unique across scripted actions and dialogue choices.

plan.description: Key of the population plan whose trail is looked for; passes when that trail is fresh in the actor's room.

partial.Connection.description: One directed exit to another room of the same cartridge (21 §5 Connection; 05 §17). Its identity is its room and direction. barrier, optional (barrier@1), names the Barrier whose one shared state the exit passes through (21 §5 Barrier; 05 §25 coherent connections): move through it is refused while it is closed (exit_closed) or locked (exit_locked); an exit without one means what it always meant. A reciprocal exit is authored in the destination room (00a §2); faces pair by opposite direction: an exit's reciprocal face is its destination's exit in the opposite compass direction when that exit leads back to its room, and an exit with a barrier needs a reciprocal face naming the same barrier (BARRIER_MISMATCH at each face otherwise). One-way and bent barrier passages (no reciprocal face, or an opposite-direction exit that leads elsewhere) are rejected for now and may be allowed later; an exit without a barrier is BARRIER_MISMATCH only when its reciprocal face names one.

barrier.description: The barrier the exit passes through.

climb.description: Toolbox row 30 (docs/system/mechanics.md rope and climb): crossing this directed exit is a climb. A mover whose body holds item (directly or in a container) climbs down as on any exit; one without it falls: the move still happens and also costs damage HP, never below 1 (a fall never kills), narrated by fell. The cartridge declares an hp pool (RESOURCE_SPEC_INVALID otherwise). NPCs never take a climb face.

damage.description: HP a fall costs; a fall never takes HP below 1.

item.description: The item a mover must hold to climb rather than fall.

corpse_ingress.description: Close this directed exit while the named global fact has the specified value, except for the living owner of a nonempty player corpse in its destination. The exception is rechecked at movement admission.

equals.description: The value at which the exit is closed.

fact.description: The global fact that closes the exit.

hidden_until.description: Toolbox row 11 (docs/system/mechanics.md hidden passages): for the commanded character this directed exit does not exist (not listed, not seen through, absent from the map, a move through it not_found) until the named fact has the specified value. No barrier on a hidden face (BARRIER_MISMATCH).

equals.description: The value that reveals the exit; of the fact's type.

fact.description: A fact of this cartridge, normally a player bool; the exit stays hidden until it has the value.

knock.description: The face's answer to a knock.

locks.description: Toolbox row G7 (mechanics.md Access locks): traverse, the policy the mover must hold to cross this exit, read by movementPlan after the barrier; failing it refuses permission_denied. Read with no target.

anyOf.description: Globally stable, immutable reference to a content definition (03 §2; 05 §4: no global content-key namespace). cartridge_id, kind and key are lowercase snake_case of at most 64 characters; cartridge_version is MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH without leading zeros, pre-release or build metadata.

cartridge_id.description: The owning cartridge. Lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.

key.description: The definition's key within its kind.

partial.DialogueChoice.description: One option of a dialogue (06 §17, §43): label and narration its text keys; steps, its effects in order (Steps of the dialogue choice context, docs/system/cartridge.md Steps and checks; a fact.assign sets a declared fact of the cartridge at the one scope it allows, a value of its type, as a scripted action's: fact@1 emits fact_changed when the value changes); hand_over, the item role the actor's body gives to the npc role (an item_acquired with that NPC as holder, as give); accept, a quest of this cartridge the choice activates as quest@1's activation does (quest.activate at player scope and quest_activated; the choose is invalid_state when accept_quest would be: the actor already has an instance of it, or its offer, if declared, has a policy that fails), never with a hand_over (activation and acquisition in one decision conflict: OUTCOME_MISMATCH). The choose that selects it applies all of them, resolves the dialogue's quest or activates the accepted one, and resolves the choice in one decision; its outcome is the choice_id. API1.7 receive {item, from} transfers the selected bound NPC-held item into the actor body, only while resolving a quest before API1.10; API1.10 also permits nonterminal receive. partial.Step.description: One registered operation of a step list, discriminated by op. Scripted action outcome's explicit steps (04 §5.2 step 4, §5.3; 05 §28: never a generic setter or an untyped effect). fact.assign sets a declared fact of the cartridge, at the one scope the fact allows, to a value of its type (the host emits fact_changed at this step's causal position when the value changes, fact@1). event.emit emits the cartridge's custom event of this key (EventPayload custom_event, scripted_action@1), whose subject is the scripted action's target. resource.adjust adds by (negative: subtracts) to a resource of the actor's body, chained after the costs and any earlier adjust of it, stopping at the resource's bounds (DikuMUD-style: healing at full health heals nothing); this saturation is the step's declared meaning, not a silent clamp (04 §5.1): the rule computes the stopped value and proposes an exact delta resource.adjust to it, or none when the value does not change. Costs never saturate (ActionCost).

anyOf.description: The action takes no target.
One entity from the listed scopes.

scopes.description: Where the target is looked for: self, inventory, room_contents, room_occupants or inspectable_details.

partial.TargetSpec.description: The candidate scopes an action's target is resolved from (21 §7): the scopes the R6P proof resolves to an EntityId. Inspectable details use target-only EntityIds and the inspectable_details scope. equipped, connections, party and privileged global scope are added with their first use, with a target identity for non-entity targets (21 §6). Accepted kinds and capabilities are added with the capability registry.

partial.TextKey.description: A localization string id (04 §15; 05 §18): lowercase dotted snake_case of at most 128 characters, the ActionDefinition label rule. Text carries its interpolation bindings. Or inline prose, written as {"prose": "..."}.

partial.UseTool.description: Toolbox row G4: what a use scripted action's tool must be, at least one property: an item whose definition declares tag, and a vessel holding some of liquid (quantity above 0).

liquid.description: A liquid the tool vessel holds some of.

tag.description: A tag the tool item definition declares.

partial.VesselSpec.description: Opted finite vessel shell with authored positive capacity and initial contents.

partial.WeaponProfile.description: An equipped weapon's required skill and authored attack profile.

durability.description: Toolbox row 21: the bounded int entity fact holding this weapon's durability (its default is a new weapon's) and the amount each hit of its own attack takes off; at the fact's minimum it is broken and strikes unarmed.

fact.description: The bounded int fact that holds the weapon's durability.

wear.description: Durability each of the weapon's hits takes off.

ranged.description: Toolbox row 17: the weapon shoots in an encounter's round 1, spending one of the body's ammo resource pool; it never strikes in melee.

ammo.description: The resource pool one unit of which each shot spends.

skill.description: The required skill.

partial.source.ActionDefinition.description: An advertised affordance (04 §19; 06 §20; 21 §7): stable key, name (its localization key), target spec, the portable Command type it resolves to (checked against the command registry when content compiles), presentation priority, required input parameters, policy and accessibility description. Aliases, costs and cooldown hints arrive with the text parser and cost capabilities.

command.description: The portable Command type it resolves to.

name.description: Text key of its name.

partial.source.BarrierDefinition.description: Shared mutable state for one logical door or gate (21 §5 Barrier), owned by barrier@1 (a cartridge with one requires it), keyed in CompiledCartridge.barriers by DefinitionRefString of kind barrier and named by the exits that pass through it (Connection.barrier): its key; keywords, the Alias words a player names it by after open, close, lock or unlock (the direction of its exit names it too); name, the text key of its short description ("the oak door"); initial, its state in a fresh world (BarrierState); and optionally key_item, the item whose holder may lock and unlock it (has_item: held directly or inside containers the holder holds). Without key_item no one can lock or unlock it. Damaged/repaired and blocked states join as optional fields. Optional tags are its property tags (entity.schema.json Tag, toolbox row G1).

initial.description: The barrier's state in a fresh world.

key_item.description: The item whose holder may lock and unlock this barrier.

keywords.description: Words a player names it by.

name.description: Text key of the barrier's short description.

opens_when.description: A condition its open command needs (toolbox row 10, barrier@1): while it fails, open is refused invalid_state; close, lock and unlock and an already open barrier are unaffected.

tags.description: Its property tags (Tag; toolbox row G1), read by the has_tag policy leaf (tag@1).

partial.source.BleedDefinition.description: An authored body bleed duration, tick cadence and HP loss.

duration.description: How long it lasts, in seconds.

narration.description: Text told as the bleed starts, repeats, ticks and ends.

applied.description: Text told when the bleed first starts on a body.

expired.description: Text told when the bleed ends by running out.

refreshed.description: Text told when the bleed is applied again while already active.

tick.description: Text told on a tick that costs hit points.

partial.source.DialogueDefinition.description: One dialogue node (06 §17; Early R7/R8 D1), keyed in CompiledCartridge.dialogues by DefinitionRefString of kind dialogue, owned by dialogue@1 (a cartridge with one requires it): its key, also the stable action key of its talk (no action's, scripted action's, quest's or registered command's: DUPLICATE_DEFINITION) and the beat of the choice it opens; npc, the speaker, whose talk the actor's ActionSet offers while the speaker is in the actor's room, and which is one of the npc roles (a speaker may have several dialogues: a talk to it opens the first, in key order, whose policy holds, and is invalid_state when none does); policy, the talk's availability, rechecked at Choose; prompt, the text key of the pending choice's prompt; roles, the participants talk binds to EntityIds in the durable choice (06 §33, §43: bound once, never re-resolved by name), each an npc that must be in the actor's room or an item the actor's body must hold when a choice is made (else not_present or not_owned), never named actor (the actor is always a participant: DUPLICATE_DEFINITION); quest, the quest a choice resolves through quest@1's resolution, with the choice_id as its outcome (absent in a dialogue with an accept choice, so accepting never resolves: OUTCOME_MISMATCH); and choices, at least one (a compiler check: the subset has no minProperties), each with its label, its narration line (committed with the actor's body and every role pinned), its fact.assign consequences and an optional hand_over of an item role to an npc role. Choices list in key order. API1.9 optionally adds riddle: its existing choice_id, lowercase canonical answer, ordered uppercase letter bank containing every answer letter with multiplicity, and wrong-answer narration text key.

entry.description: An optional marker: talk to this speaker opens this dialogue and no other of theirs but keyword ones, over the inferred entry (dialogue@1). At most one per speaker; not on a keyword dialogue.

keyword.description: Toolbox row G9 (speech@1): a say or whisper of this word to the speaker opens this dialogue, which talk never offers or opens; no riddle.

name.description: A distinct name (the Talk label) opts that authored control into exact dialogue selection; omission retains first-eligible Talk.

npc.description: The speaker, also an npc role.

prompt.description: Text key of the pending choice's prompt.

quest.description: The quest a choice resolves, with the choice id as its outcome.

riddle.description: A riddle answered by a typed word.

answer.description: The answer that solves the riddle, compared lowercased.

bank.description: The letters an answer may use, each once per entry; an answer that does not fit is refused.

choice_id.description: The choice that takes a typed answer.

wrong.description: Line told after a wrong answer.

wrong_limit.description: Wrong answers allowed; the last one closes the choice for good. Leave out for unlimited tries. Needs the dialogue's quest.

roles.description: Participants bound when the talk opens.

partial.source.EmoteDefinition.description: NPC emotes (G9, emote@1; cartridge.md Emote declarations): one canned emote an NPC performs. Its key; others, the text key of the line every reader but the target reads ({actor}, the emoter); optional to, the forms with a target: to.others for the other readers ({actor}, {target}) and to.you for the target ({actor}). No label and no self form: only NPCs emote.

others.description: Text key of the line every reader but the target reads.
Text key for the other readers.

partial.source.ItemDefinition.description: A portable thing (21 §8): its key; keywords, the Alias words a player names it by (target resolution); name, the text key of its short description ("a brass lantern"); room_line, the text key of the line a room shows while it lies there ("A brass lantern sits here."), with room_line_variants (DescriptionVariant, first match wins, as for a room's description); description, the text key examine shows; location, where a fresh world puts it; and optionally container: true, making it a receptacle; only receptacles may declare capacity, the most items held directly (without capacity a receptacle has no limit); optionally slot, the SlotKey it is worn in (equipment@1), with optional affects (ItemAffect), each added to the wearer's attribute while the item is worn (toolbox row 3; needs slot and attribute@1); and optionally barrier, the barrier on it (a container's lid, barrier@1, c1-locks): a barrier of this cartridge that no exit and no other item names (BARRIER_MISMATCH), whose state the door verbs change with the item as target_id; while it is closed or locked, what the item holds is out of reach (containment@1 custody). Optional mass_grams is the shell mass, required for every item when world.carry is authored. Optional tags are its property tags (Tag, toolbox row G1). Optional name_variants and description_variants vary its name and description (TextVariants, toolbox row W6). Optional words are its name words (NameWords, loka-6qi).

barrier.description: The barrier on it, a container lid.

behaviours.description: Behaviours this entity takes on: each adds one copy of the behaviour's rules, with `{"param": "holder"}` replaced by this entity's key.

block_chance.description: Percent chance that this shield blocks while held.

capacity.description: Most items held directly; receptacles only.

container.description: Only explicitly authored receptacles hold items. Absence is false; capacity and barrier require this field.

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms from this item: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

equip.description: Authored wear and remove words (toolbox row 6a, loka-x6t.20): the Wear and Remove labels and the worn and removed lines. Only with slot; each key is in the text catalog.

worn.description: The line told when the item is worn.

fuel.description: Makes the item a lightable fuel source that burns while lit, or a supply that refuels one.

give_allowed.description: API1.10: false prevents ordinary Give of this item or any container holding it transitively; absence permits Give when contents allow it. Dialogue hand_over remains legal.

identified.description: Toolbox row 27: a boolean fact, not per_subject; the item is identified while it reads true for the player, and GameView worn sums identified items only (needs affects).

immune.description: Toolbox row G3: statuses that status.apply skips on this item's instance; each names a declared status.

intended_level.description: Balance tool 6b: the level the item is meant for, read only by the power report's gear budget (needs affects; the engine ignores it at runtime).

keywords.description: Words a player names it by.

location.description: Where a fresh world puts it.

locks.description: Toolbox row G7 (mechanics.md Access locks): get, the policy an actor must hold to take this item or anything inside it, and put, the policy to put an item into it (a container only: compiler SCHEMA_VIOLATION invalid_value at locks.put). Each is optional (absent holds) and read with this item as target; failing it refuses permission_denied.

mass_grams.description: The item shell mass in grams, excluding its contents. Required on every item under world.carry; explicit zero is valid (docs/system/cartridge.md Carrying settings and item mass).
