source.RoomDefinition.description: A navigable place (21 §5 Place/Room): its key, its name and description text keys (05 §18; resolved in the cartridge text catalog), and its exits by compass direction, the six-way compass of 00 §4.10 (a direction without an exit is absent), optionally its inspectable details by key, at most 64, its description variants (DescriptionVariant) and its contributions to the ActionSet of an actor in it, applied in order (action.schema.json ActionContribution; R5 S5, optional). Custom named connections (05 §17) join later as a separate optional field. Optional tags are its property tags (entity.schema.json Tag, toolbox row G1).

cues.description: Sense cues reaching nearby rooms: 1 to 4 of {sense, text, range, when?}.

dark.description: The room is dark (light@1): a player without light, or blind, reads the engine line place.dark instead of the description and sees none of the room's entities. An authored dark_description wins over the engine line.

dark_description.description: Shown instead of the description while the room is dark; authoring it marks the room as having no light of its own.

locks.description: Toolbox row G7 (mechanics.md Access locks): enter, the policy the mover must hold to come into this room, read by movementPlan after the exit's traverse lock; failing it refuses permission_denied. Read with no target.

name.description: Text key of its name.

sanctuary.description: Combat cannot be opened here and hostile NPCs do not engage on entry.

site.description: Built rooms S1 (construction@1; cartridge.md Structure and site declarations): where a structure may be built from this room. directions, the compass directions a built room may open on, none an authored exit of this room (SITE_EXIT_CONFLICT); structures, the StructureDefinitions that may be built here (UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE otherwise).

directions.description: Compass directions a built room may take from here.

structures.description: Structures that may be built from this room.

tags.description: Its property tags (Tag; toolbox row G1), read by the has_tag policy leaf (tag@1) and the terrain fare (row 43a); unique, since a repeated tag would apply its fare percent twice.

zones.description: The zones this room belongs to; a reaction with `zone` and no `on.room` gets one copy per member room.

on.description: What starts the scene: a story point reached, a quest outcome, or a scripted action's success; an action start names the scripted action's room and detail.

source.SceneDefinition.description: Modal narration or the consumed paid-Rest anchored, resumable presentation-only dream.

source.ScriptedAction.description: A cartridge-local action composed only of registered operations (06 §20 Composed actions / ScriptedAction; 21 §7; 05 §28), invoked by the perform command: its stable key (its ActionSet identity), name, the aliases a player types as its verb (the first words of the command), its target, presentation priority, availability policy (evaluated for the actor; while it fails the action is shown unavailable and perform is rejected), and its outcomes. success is one explicit list of at most 16 steps, run in order as one logical decision (04 §5.2) and followed by the engine's action_completed event, and the narration its actor reads; observers is the line others in the room would read, kept for the first host with a second viewer. Optional (R5 S6): a check (step.schema.json Check; check@1), whose result selects the outcome: success when it passes, failure when it fails; a scripted action has a failure outcome exactly when it has a check (OUTCOME_MISMATCH). A failed check is an accepted perform with outcome failure whose RNG draw and time commit like success (04 §5.0); a scripted action without a check has outcome performed. failure's steps may be empty. duration, a whole number of LogicalTime units, advances the clock by that much on every accepted perform, success or failure (21 §7 Cost, time; 04 §5.4: one time.advance after the outcome's steps); events keep the time the perform was admitted at. action_completed follows the outcome's steps when the outcome is performed or success, never failure. Optional (R5 S6b): costs (ActionCost, resource@1), paid in order by the actor's body on every admitted perform, failure included; one it cannot pay rejects the perform insufficient_resource before any check or draw. cooldown, a whole number of LogicalTime units: a perform by the same actor before the last admitted attempt's time plus cooldown is rejected cooldown; an admitted attempt, failure included, starts it at its admission time (delta cooldown.start), and at exactly that time plus cooldown the scripted action is available again. Admission order: target, cooldown, costs, then the check. Optional (toolbox row W23, fact@1): tip, a text the actor reads once, after the outcome's narration, on the first accepted perform (success, failure or performed); that perform also assigns the engine-owned player fact seen_tip_<key> (bool, default false) true, which the compiler adds, so a scripted action with a tip has a key of at most 55 characters and no definition writes that fact (RESERVED_FACT). Optional (loka-j64e): reason, a text key the GameView adds as the message of an offered ActionSet action's (or learned spell word's) unavailable reason while its policy fails (a use-target scripted action is hidden then, so its reason is not shown); the perform or cast refusal stays invalid_state. Optional (Homestead hs-10): craft (ActionCraft), the items a station scripted action uses up and makes; a spell scripted action has none (SCHEMA_VIOLATION). Result bands join later.

aliases.description: Words a player types as its verb.

check.description: A check selecting success or failure.

cooldown.description: The action is refused until this much logical time has passed since the actor's last admitted attempt.

duration.description: Logical time every accepted perform advances.

name.description: Text key of its name.

cues.description: Transient cues of this outcome (toolbox row G6), from the actor's room: perceived only by a cue_perceived condition of a reaction this outcome's check_passed, check_failed or action_completed causes; never stored or shown.

success.description: Runs when the check passes, or when the action has no check.

cues.description: Transient cues of this outcome (toolbox row G6), from the actor's room: perceived only by a cue_perceived condition of a reaction this outcome's check_passed, check_failed or action_completed causes; never stored or shown.

reason.description: The refusal text shown when the action's policy fails.

tip.description: A line the actor reads once, after the outcome's lines, on the first accepted perform.

source.ServiceDefinition.description: Exact original-provider action and conserved quote with one typed immediate benefit.

benefit.description: Closed paid entitlement, finite meal recovery, provider-owned complete liquid serving (recovery is MV only) or, toolbox row 21, a repair adding up to amount to the wielded weapon's durability fact; or, toolbox row 20b, a claim or cancel of the named commission service's timed escrow order; or, toolbox row 25, a deposit or withdraw of amount between the player's pool and the vault NPC's, mirrored in the account fact, the price being the fee; or, Built rooms S2 to S5, a build, mend or raze of a site's room. One Step whose op is one of these 11 (C3 D5; the compiler refuses any other op, SCHEMA_VIOLATION invalid_value at benefit.op).

name.description: Text key of the service's name.

narration.description: Text told when the service is used.

price.description: Row kgd.70: 0 only on an entitlement with escrow, a barter.

source.SkillDefinition.description: An acquired skill with authored display text and a policy for current qualification.

growth.description: Toolbox row 5 (docs/system/mechanics.md skill growth): strictly increasing use counts reaching levels 2, 3 and so on above the base; the count is the reserved player fact uses_<key>.

hidden.description: Homestead hs-14 (docs/system/mechanics.md Skill trees): the skill is left out of GameView skills, and of NPC lessons, while its prerequisite fails and it is not acquired. A dialogue choice that teaches it is not offered while it is so left out. A non-hidden skill whose prerequisite or qualification reads a hidden skill, a dialogue policy that reads one, and a dialogue label on a dialogue that teaches one are refused.

name.description: Text key of its display name.

prerequisite.description: Homestead hs-11 (docs/system/mechanics.md Skill trees): read for the acquiring actor with no target; skill.acquire is refused while it fails. A skill_compare naming this skill is refused.

profession.description: Homestead hs-14 (docs/system/book-ui.md Skill tree details): the profession heading this skill is listed under on the Character page.

source.StatusDefinition.description: Toolbox row 1: one authored timed status on a body. Every tick_every seconds until duration ends, per_tick (signed) is added to resource, saturating at the pool bounds; a negative hp result at zero runs the death sequence. Applied by a reaction status.apply; ended by expiry, an edible that cures it, or death. A reapplication while active refreshes ends_at and keeps the pending tick. Optional modifies (row 2c) adds attribute modifiers, read at use while active; a status with modifies may omit per_tick, and then never ticks (its one job is the expiry).

allows.description: Status reader 4: the only Command types the holding body may issue while the status is active (a modal answer aside); named as blocks; may stand in for per_tick.

blocks.description: Status reader 4: Command types (CommandPayload type) the holding body may not issue while the status is active; each names a registered command other than run_job and elapsed (compiler UNKNOWN_COMMAND); may stand in for per_tick.

concealment.description: Status reader 8: while active on an NPC, the player does not see it; on the player's body, an NPC does not engage it on entry. invisible yields to a see_invisible perception; hidden to none, unless pierced_by. May stand in for per_tick.

cues.description: Cues active while this status is active on a holder, from the holder's room (toolbox row G6).

duration.description: Logical seconds, or permanent (toolbox row W8): no expiry and no job, kept by the same-body return, ended only by a cure; a permanent status that declares per_tick ticks until cured, with no ends_at (loka-rn3b).

fear.description: Toolbox row W21: while active on a pack member, its C4 flight is attempted on its every opponent turn, whatever its hp; may stand in for per_tick.

kind.description: Toolbox row loka-x6t.64: the status icon's polarity, shown as GameView ConditionView.kind; wins over the polarity derived from the effect fields.

modifies.description: Toolbox row 2c: while the status is active on a holder, each modifier is added to the holder's attribute as attribute@1 reads it.

movement.description: Status reader 7: the holding body's move cost and the terrain it may cross while the status is active; may stand in for per_tick.

cost_percent.description: Percent of each move's fare (world.movement.cost or 1 mv, after the flee multiplier) the holding body pays, rounded down; several statuses apply in turn in definition order.

passes.description: Terrain tags the holding body may enter: a move into a room tagged air, chasm or water is refused invalid_state unless the body's active statuses pass each such tag.

name.description: Text key of its name.

narration.description: Text told as the status is applied, ticks and ends.

applied.description: Text told when the status is applied.

expired.description: Told when a timed status ends; required unless duration is permanent (compiler SCHEMA_VIOLATION, loka-rn3b).

observed.description: Row G3 (loka-kgd.176): told when a first application lands on an NPC or item in the player's room that the player perceives, or on the room the player stands in (loka-x6t.37); with none, such a holder is silent.

skipped.description: Told, whole, when this status bars its holder's combat blow (loka-x6t.30); with none, the round tells the engine line combat.skipped, its bindings.status this status's name.

tick.description: Text told on each tick of the status.

per_tick.description: Signed; never 0, required unless modifies, fear, blocks, allows, resistances, perception, concealment or movement is present or duration is permanent (compiler SCHEMA_VIOLATION).

perception.description: Status reader 6: what the holding body perceives while the status is active. sight blind: every room is dark to it, a lit source or dark sight notwithstanding; dark_sight: sees in an unlit room as an ancestry's dark_sight does; see_invisible: sees a holder of an invisible status. hearing deaf: no sound cue reaches it. At least one field (compiler SCHEMA_VIOLATION); may stand in for per_tick.

hearing.description: deaf: no sound cue reaches the holder.

sight.description: Changes what the holder sees: blind (every room is dark), dark_sight (sees in an unlit room) or see_invisible (sees holders of an invisible status).

pierced_by.description: Toolbox row 16, only beside concealment: a seer whose attribute value (an NPC's declared value, a player's attribute@1 value) is greater than the holder's skill level sees through the concealment; a holder without a character is never pierced. No draw. While the holder is a player's body, an NPC that engages it on entry ends every active concealment status on it.

attribute.description: The attribute whose value the seer needs; it is compared with the holder's skill level.

skill.description: The skill whose level the seer's attribute value must beat to see through the concealment.

resistances.description: Status reader 5: while active on the struck body (the player's or an NPC's), each entry joins the G2 resistance sum of an attack on it, before the one -100..100 clamp; may stand in for per_tick.

source.StructureDefinition.description: Built rooms S1 (construction@1; cartridge.md Structure and site declarations): one structure a player may build at a room's site (RoomDefinition.site). Its key; name and description, the text keys of the room it becomes; optional variants (DescriptionVariant) and tags (Tag) as a room's; optional locks.enter, the policy the mover must hold to come into the built room, as a room's (toolbox row G7). Nothing builds in S1: the cartridge declares and both compilers check. Built rooms S3: optional max_per_owner, the most rooms of this structure one character may own at once; an order at the cap is refused service.construction_full. Built rooms S4: optional weathering, a status of this cartridge the room gets when it is raised (and again when mended); optional ruin, the status a mend cures (a reaction applies it, typically on weathering's status_expired), the mend benefit refuses service.nothing_to_mend unless ruin is active on the room.

ruin.description: The status a mend cures; mending is refused unless the room has it.

weathering.description: The status the room gets when it is raised and again when mended.

source.cartridge.description: A cartridge's manifest (05 §3, §20): identity, title, compatibility requirements and supported profiles (at least one; order and duplicates carry no meaning). Fields that freeze with their feature (entry, locales, activation groups, continuity, time policy) are added then (14 §R3B).

alternates.description: Narration variety (alternates@1, toolbox row W7): a text key's alternates, each a key of the text catalog; a committed narration line with that key shows one of the key and its alternates, chosen by a hash of the command id and the key (mechanics.md narration variety), never the authority RNG.

ancestries.description: Authored once-only character choices (attribute@1), keyed by choice Key.

api_version.description: The source format family this cartridge is written in; always loka/v3.

chapters.description: Optional ordered chapter markers; absent preserves earlier cartridge bytes and meaning.

entry.description: The room a fresh world puts the player's body in.

id.description: The cartridge's identity; every definition key and reference carries it.

speech.description: Word bar S2 (speech@1): phrases, the cartridge's static say words, each a speech@1 Word, offered to every actor with no fact gate; GameView projects them as phrases. In source it is cartridge.json's speech, beside world.

phrases.description: The words every player can say, as chips in the say bar.

supported_profiles.description: The hosting profiles this cartridge runs under; at least one (offline_private, online_private, party, shared_area).

title.description: The cartridge's name as listed for the player.

additionalProperties.description: A typed, namespaced fact declaration (03 §7): key (the fact's DefinitionRef is cartridge@version:fact/key; the cartridge is the namespace, 05 §4), versioned type, default, allowed scope kinds (a set) and meaning. Transition constraints and the reference graph are added with the compiler (R4).

meaning.description: What the fact means, for authors. The rules do not read it.

npc_pair.description: Toolbox row FD4: a pair fact between two NPCs, one value per ordered pair (the subject NPC toward the with NPC), stored with subject_id and with_id. Needs per_subject and scopes exactly [instance] (world state).

per_subject.description: Toolbox row W2: the fact has one value per subject, an NPC, item or detail, stored with its subject_id (ScopedFact): an entity fact at scope instance, a pair fact (the subject and the character) at scope player. Absent: one value per scope.

scopes.description: The scope kinds allowed. This kernel accepts exactly one, `player` or `instance`.

value_type.description: The fact's type and default value.

version.description: The version of the fact's type.
